quotes.text: A service observer registered with a weak reference must declare QueryInterface with the observer and weak-reference interfaces. Account color handling also removes its service observers on unload. DOM listeners and service observers have different ownership; inspect the source before adding or removing cleanup. D211687 explicitly caught the missing QueryInterface.
